correctness.rationale: Proved exhaustion: any factor containing >=2 markers has a unique full interior gap; hence no closed factor contains >=3 markers. One-marker closed factors are precisely balanced zero fringes; for two markers the exact necessary/sufficient return condition is b<=g_j, with all boundary indices checked including k=1. Disjoint enumeration yields the formula. From the actual bundled verify.py path, independent brute factor/border enumeration passed 4095 gap vectors and 797251 closed-factor instances, plus ramp identity k=1..15. Finite checks supplement the complete proof.

value.rationale: This is an exact natural infinite-parameter classification of complete first returns for arbitrarily prescribed strictly increasing gap lengths. Its explicit multivariate formula reveals sensitivity to boundary contexts and quantitatively realizes all closed-factor growth exponents from 3/2 to 2 (including quadratic density), relative to established global closed-rich theory. The contribution is not a trivial finite table, a mere renaming, or an unrestricted extremal claim.
